summary: Practise tender red-flag analysis, ownership checks, and investigation handoffs. Explore procurement fraud risk training and course details.
lede: Procurement fraud analytics helps procurement, audit, compliance, and investigation teams assess tender risks and support consistent escalation. Learners practise screening tender and supplier data for bid-pattern indicators, checking ownership against available records, and documenting conflicts and exceptions. They also build red-flag scorecards, control maps, and evidence-based handoff materials, with advanced analytics and beneficial ownership data standards covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage procurement activity, test controls, review tender data, or respond to suspected procurement fraud across public, donor-funded, construction, health, and large supply-chain environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement, audit, compliance, contract management, or investigation processes is recommended. No programming is required. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful for the Excel-based exercises.
